# Retained cleanup tail

Exact Metapad 3.6 transfers from RVA 0x560d through return, with the resource
callee retained only for original-byte provenance. The public tail proof copies
and compiles the root function and runtime support; it imports a separately
checked resource contract instead of compiling either supplier body.

The manual boundary selects a terminal region inside the existing ordinary C
cleanup component. It does not introduce a production API or independently
authorize the complete component. The contract records image/call bindings and
the supported stack/view convention. Concrete caller/service/lifetime and
entry/loop/tail composition remain separate obligations.
